309:        """Poll the connection and dispatch incoming events"""
310:        assert self.qtile is not None
311:
312:        while True:
313:            try:
314:                event = self.conn.conn.poll_for_event()
315:                if not event:
316:                    break
317:
318:                if event.__class__ in _IGNORED_EVENTS:
319:                    continue
320:
321:                # Motion Notifies are handled later
322:                # Otherwise this is too CPU intensive
323:                if isinstance(event, xcffib.xproto.MotionNotifyEvent):
324:                    self._motion_notify = event
325:                else:
326:                    # These events need the motion notify event handled first
327:                    handle_motion_first = type(event) in [
328:                        xcffib.xproto.EnterNotifyEvent,
329:                        xcffib.xproto.LeaveNotifyEvent,
330:                        xcffib.xproto.ButtonPressEvent,
331:                        xcffib.xproto.ButtonReleaseEvent,
332:                    ]
333:                    # Handle events in the correct order
334:                    if self._motion_notify and handle_motion_first:
335:                        self.handle_event(self._motion_notify)
336:                        self._motion_notify = None
337:                    self.handle_event(event)
338:
339:            # Catch some bad X exceptions. Since X is event based, race
340:            # conditions can occur almost anywhere in the code. For example, if
341:            # a window is created and then immediately destroyed (before the
342:            # event handler is evoked), when the event handler tries to examine
343:            # the window properties, it will throw a WindowError exception. We
344:            # can essentially ignore it, since the window is already dead and
345:            # we've got another event in the queue notifying us to clean it up.
346:            except (
347:                xcffib.xproto.WindowError,
348:                xcffib.xproto.AccessError,
349:                xcffib.xproto.DrawableError,
350:                xcffib.xproto.GContextError,
351:                xcffib.xproto.PixmapError,
352:                xcffib.render.PictureError,
353:            ):
354:                pass
355:            except Exception:
356:                error_code = self.conn.conn.has_error()
357:                if error_code:
358:                    logger.warning("Shutting down due to disconnection from X server")
359:                    self.remove_listener()
360:                    self.qtile.stop()
361:                    return
362:                logger.exception("Got an exception in poll loop")
363:        # Handle any outstanding motion notify events
364:        if self._motion_notify:
365:            self.handle_event(self._motion_notify)
366:            self._motion_notify = None
367:        self.flush()"}
